data.title: Madoro Updates Proposed Reverse Takeover and Québec Lithium Property Option
data.description:
Madoro Metals Corp ( (TSE:MDM) ) has provided an announcement.

Madoro Metals and Narrow River Resources continue work on the proposed reverse takeover, including responding to TSXV comments and completing transaction documents and disclosure. Subject to TSXV review and approval, Madoro currently anticipates a shareholder meeting in the first quarter of 2027; the date has not been set, while its annual meeting is scheduled for December 15, 2026.

The proposed non-brokered private placement was revised to up to C$1.45 million through 29 million hard-dollar units priced at C$0.05, each including one share and half a warrant; each whole warrant carries a C$0.08 exercise price for two years. Madoro also agreed to pay C$30,000 by December 31, 2026, to waive remaining exploration commitments and complete its option to acquire 100% of First Green, subject to TSXV approval.
